headline: SaaS Implementation Consultant | Discovery, Workflow Design and Configuration | Customer Training
summary: Four years at Greenway Health, a US EHR software company, owning end-to-end implementations for close to 200 client practices, from discovery workshops through configuration, go-live and adoption. I document how each customer works today, design the workflow they need, configure it, and train the people who use it (200+ trained). I also work on the product side: I write requirements documents from recurring customer problems and have built and launched my own SaaS product with paying pilot clients, including billing and API integrations.
greenway_bullets: Owned end-to-end implementations for close to 200 client practices, from discovery and workflow documentation through configuration, go-live support and adoption.
Ran discovery with each customer to document pain points, processes and goals, then designed and configured customer-specific workflows.
Trained 200+ end users, from providers to nurses and medical assistants, on the new workflows.
Wrote PRDs and feature requests from recurring customer problems and worked with product teams to get them built; many shipped to clients.
Took part in UAT and SIT, and triaged defects from detection through stage-gate release as a member of the Patient Safety and Functional Advisory Committees.
Clinical lead for a new AI-first EHR from Aug 2025: defined user personas, mapped end-to-end workflows and built React prototypes before engineering handoff.
Presented to clients and at the Greenway Engage provider conference.
skills: customer discovery, requirements gathering, current- and future-state workflow mapping, configuration, go-live support, UAT and SIT, MS Project, SharePoint
role-based training, documentation and SOP writing, stakeholder communication, customer workshops and presentations
PRDs, defect triage, API and webhook integrations, subscription billing, prototyping
thesis_html: Customers get live faster when the person configuring it has listened first.
facts: Built and launched my own product
why_fit: Documented each customer's workflows and pain points, then designed and configured to fit.
